propositions: The DC harness errors all 62 cells at fixture setup because the session-start readiness gate waits for Epic Link/Epic Name fields that only exist after the first Jira Software project is created, creating a deadlock where the gate blocks the action that would provision the fields.

Epic Link and Epic Name are provisioned by GreenHopper when the first Jira Software project is created, not at plugin startup, so checking for them at session start before any project exists is fundamentally impossible regardless of timeout budget.

The root cause is an ordering bug, not a timing shortfall: experiment 30981084637 proved that 180 seconds of idle time produced no change in field inventory, but creating a project yielded the fields within 0.0512 seconds.
The readiness check must be relocated from wait_for_jira_dc_ready (session start) to _assert_project_capabilities (immediately after project creation) to fix the ordering deadlock.
The misleading decision rule in not_ready_message that blamed timeout budgets for absent custom fields must be corrected to point to the provisioning precondition instead.
